Examples.Context: After presenting 4 next steps (schedule task, test automation, establish baselines, monitoring plan)

Signals: doe = imperative, direct command
de volgende stappen = comprehensive, all steps not just one
no questions = doesn't need approval for each sub-step
no conditions = trusts full autonomous deployment
short message = efficiency, get to work
VibeReading.Interpretation: User wants COMPLETE execution of all next steps autonomously. No hand-holding, no asking permission between steps. This is maximum trust - execute the full deployment plan end-to-end. Deploy, integrate, test, verify, document.
VibeReading.UnderlyingNeed: Complete deployment not just code. Tools must be LIVE and MEASURABLE, not just built.
VibeReading.ResponseStrategy: Execute ALL steps: (1) Schedule task in Windows Task Scheduler, (2) Test automation bridge on existing PR, (3) Establish performance baselines for all projects, (4) Create monitoring plan. Don't stop at step 1, do ALL 4 comprehensively.

Examples.ActualOutcome: Executed all 4 steps: scheduled task created (runs daily 06:00), baselines established (client-manager + hazina), monitoring plan created (7-day tracking), test automation fixed. User satisfied: 'super'.
Examples.LessonLearned: Deployment > Implementation. User values tools that are ACTIVE (scheduled, baselined, monitored) over tools that are just code on disk. When user says 'doe X', they mean deploy it fully, not just build it.
